| When I… | I use… | So I can… | Resources |
|---|---|---|---|
| *Reactivity* | | | |
| have a costly filter used by multiple outputs | `@reactive.calc` | reuse one computation across dependent outputs, reducing redundancy | [app](https://github.com/UBC-MDS/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/blob/main/code/lecture02/core/app-05-reactive_calc_reuse.py) · [L03](https://ubc-mds.github.io/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/slides/03-reactivity.html) [L04](https://dsci532-review-pages.netlify.app/slides/04-dashboard-core.html) · [docs](https://shiny.posit.co/py/docs/reactive-foundations.html) |
| need a side effect to run only when specific inputs change | `@reactive.event` | avoid unintended side effects from reactive cascades | [L03](https://ubc-mds.github.io/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/slides/03-reactivity.html) · [docs](https://shiny.posit.co/py/docs/reactive-patterns.html) |
| need to trigger a reset or action on button click | `@reactive.event(input.btn)` + `@reactive.effect` | run DB writes or UI resets exactly when the user asks | [L03](https://ubc-mds.github.io/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/slides/03-reactivity.html) · [docs](https://shiny.posit.co/py/docs/reactive-patterns.html) |
| *Data I/O* | | | |
| want my app to react to users sorting/filtering/selecting rows | `DataGrid` + `.data_view()` | build logic on what the user sees | [app](https://github.com/UBC-MDS/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/blob/main/code/lecture03/tables/app-04-table-linked.py) · [L06a](https://ubc-mds.github.io/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/slides/06a-tables.html) · [docs](https://shiny.posit.co/py/components/outputs/data-grid/) |
| need to give users a data file (csv/…) | `@render.download` + `download_button` | let users take some results out of the app | [L06a](https://ubc-mds.github.io/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/slides/06a-tables.html) · [docs](https://shiny.posit.co/py/components/outputs/download-button/) |
| need to save user input or logs across sessions | external DB + `@reactive.effect` (with `@reactive.event`) | store data in a way that survives multiple sessions and server restarts | [app-03](https://github.com/UBC-MDS/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/blob/main/code/lecture07/app-03.py) [app-04](https://github.com/UBC-MDS/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/blob/main/code/lecture07/app-04.py) · [L09](https://ubc-mds.github.io/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/slides/09-databases.html) · [docs](https://shiny.posit.co/py/docs/persistent-data-storage.html) |
| have a dataset too large to load at startup | Parquet + DuckDB [+ ibis] | keep the app fast without loading everything into memory | [app](https://github.com/UBC-MDS/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/blob/main/code/lecture07/app-02b-taxi-parquet.py) · [L09](https://ubc-mds.github.io/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/slides/09-databases.html) · [ibis](https://ibis-project.org/) [DuckDB](https://duckdb.org/docs/) |
| *LLM & AI* | | | |
| want to embed a chat interface in my dashboard | `QueryChat` | let users explore data conversationally, in context | [app-07e](https://github.com/UBC-MDS/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/blob/main/code/lecture05/demo01/app-07e-querychat-instructions.py) [app-07f](https://github.com/UBC-MDS/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/blob/main/code/lecture05/demo01/app-07f-two-tabs.py) · [L07d](https://ubc-mds.github.io/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/slides/07d-dashboards.html) · [querychat](https://posit-dev.github.io/querychat/) |
| need to constrain what the LLM answers about | `system_prompt` + data description | focus the assistant on your data and prevent off-topic responses | [L07d](https://ubc-mds.github.io/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/slides/07d-dashboards.html) · [querychat](https://posit-dev.github.io/querychat/) |
| want the LLM to use instruments and tools | `chat.register_tool()` (chatlas) | extend the LLM with external functionality and data access | [L08a](https://ubc-mds.github.io/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/slides/08a-tools.html) · [chatlas](https://posit-dev.github.io/chatlas/tool-calling.html) |
| need structured fields from unstructured text | Pydantic + structured output | extract structured fields to use in code or output in a particular format | [L08b](https://ubc-mds.github.io/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/slides/08b-structured.html) · [pydantic](https://docs.pydantic.dev/) |
| need the LLM to answer questions about my specific domain | RAG (per-query injection) | get correct answers without fine-tuning | [rag_demo](https://github.com/UBC-MDS/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/blob/main/code/lecture07/rag/rag_demo.ipynb) · [L08c](https://ubc-mds.github.io/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/slides/08c-rag.html) · [LlamaIndex](https://docs.llamaindex.ai/) |
| want to log what users ask the LLM | `on_tool_request` hook + external DB | audit trail without blocking the flow | [app-04](https://github.com/UBC-MDS/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/blob/main/code/lecture07/app-04.py) · [L09](https://ubc-mds.github.io/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/slides/09-databases.html) · [querychat](https://posit-dev.github.io/querychat/) |
| want to measure if prompt changes improve output | `inspect_ai` evals | compare models and iterate with evidence | [L08e](https://ubc-mds.github.io/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/slides/08e-evals_inspect.html) · [inspect.ai](https://inspect.ai/) |
| *Geospatial* | | | |
| need to show geographic patterns | Altair choropleth / point map | explore regional variation interactively | [app-04](https://github.com/UBC-MDS/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/blob/main/code/lecture03/maps/app-04-map-and-chart.py) [app-05](https://github.com/UBC-MDS/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/blob/main/code/lecture03/maps/app-05-map-click.py) · [L05a](https://ubc-mds.github.io/DSCI_532_vis-2_book/slides/05a-geoviz.html) · [Altair maps](https://altair-viz.github.io/gallery/index.html#maps) |
